items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I rehearsed with him a few times at a club called The Twelve Horsemen

ctx.x: Before I get any further, there's one guy I want to mention. Because this guy was so spectacular, I don't think I've ever heard anybody play a saxophone more personable than he did. He sounded like he was inside of his instrument. I rehearsed with him a few times at a club called The Twelve Horsemen, over on Jonorra(?) Street. And this guy had the warmest feeling! You could just feel it, you know, like there was heat coming off his instrument when he played. His name was Eddie Loven(?). And some years later, he…
